resource.name: VanityFilter
resource.creator: Sputnik Digital Effects
resource.description: Local skin retouching with per-person masks and plate/matte exports for Resolve. Paid license or paid demo; activation checks required.
resource.platformNotes: Windows 10 1809+/11 x64 or Apple Silicon macOS 14+. No Intel Mac support. Local video processing; up to 30 days offline between license checks.

requirements.dependencies: Internet activation/license checks; models and codecs are included.

evidence.note: Windows 10 1809+/11 x64 or Apple Silicon macOS 14+. No Intel Mac support. Local video processing; up to 30 days offline between license checks.

Standalone skin-retouching app that exports processed plates or grayscale mask mattes for Resolve compositing. Supports per-person selection and batch processing; skin processing runs on the CPU. The source audio is re-encoded on export. Paid perpetual license and a paid time-limited demo; activation and periodic checks need internet.
Explicit provider version; exact release date not established.
